title: Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.08179v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a student on its own reasoning, using the same model conditioned on reference solutions as a teacher. Applying OPSD to multilingual reasoning requires the teacher to provide useful feedback across languages, even when the student makes mistakes in intermediate steps. We observe a phenomenon we call Teacher Drift: as these mistakes accumulate, the teacher may follow the student's incorrect steps instead of correcting them. Our analysis shows that this shift tends to occur earlier in lower-resource languages. To account for these differences across languages, we propose Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation (TOPSD), which determines where and whether teacher supervision should be applied to each reasoning trajectory. translated_title: 知道何时教学：从多语言推理蒸馏中的可教学前缀学习
translated_abstract: 同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过在学生模型自身的推理结果上进行训练来提升推理能力，其中使用同一模型并以参考解答为条件来充当教师模型。将OPSD应用于多语言推理时，要求教师模型即使面对学生模型在中间步骤中出现的错误，也能在各种语言中提供有用的反馈。我们观察到一种称之为“教师漂移”的现象：随着这些错误的累积，教师模型可能会跟随学生模型的错误步骤，而不是纠正它们。我们的分析表明，这种转变在低资源语言中往往发生得更早。为了应对这些跨语言差异，我们提出了可教学同策略自蒸馏（TOPSD），它可以确定在每个推理轨迹上是否应用以及在何处应用教师监督。TOPSD利用教师-学生似然来估计漂移开始的位置，并选择一个前缀进行监督，然后验证教师模型是否能够恢复……
tldr: 提出TOPSD方法，利用教师-学生似然估计教师漂移的起点并选择可教学前缀进行监督，解决了多语言推理自蒸馏中的教师漂移问题，尤其改善了低资源语言的推理表现。
en_tdlr: Proposes TOPSD, which uses teacher-student likelihood to detect where teacher drift begins and selects teachable prefixes for supervision, addressing the teacher drift problem in multilingual reasoning self-distillation, particularly benefiting lower-resource languages.
